main_text.p: duobus posterioribus vero amicam auri cum radicibus minerarum conjunctionem, & inde consequentem tincturam completitur: quae satis est hactenus veluti intenso digito commonstrasse.

Nunc quoniam satis superq; videmur probasse aurum Philosophicum nostrum ex inferiorib9 metallis arte & natura productum praestare nobis tincturam auri Philosophici à Lapide distinctam, rem totam ex Basilio concludemus. Scribit igitur Valentinus in occulta Philosophia sua sub finem de cervo,cujus cornua ex auro puro erant, qua multa corniculorum, sive amorum, millia, acquisiverunt, qui quidem cervus in sylvam viridem cucurrerit, quem venatores usq; in hodiernum diem investigent

page.notes: The woodcut border surrounds the text block; no marginal notes. Word "Philosophicum" and "inferiorib9" are printed as shown. "acquisiverunt" and "amorum" follow the print; "sive amorum" reading is uncertain and marked here as printed. Show-through from the facing page appears at the right edge and is excluded.
